dct_description_sm:
Set describing the administrative territories of the barracks on the entire island of Montreal.

The [Fire Stations on the Island of Montreal] data set (fire stations) provides the location of the fire stations.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
